_comment: Authoritative release-gate status (ADR-008 Stage 3). External gates that CANNOT run in repository-verification are represented here explicitly as OPEN/BLOCKED with their closure requirement -- they are never turned green by being skipped. ci/check_release_gates_status.py validates this file: a gate may be marked CLOSED only with an evidence_commit pointer to executable evidence. Repository-verification (the green-capable, repo-owned job) and the runnable fail-closed jobs live in .github/workflows/release-gates.yml.

gates.reason: No approved EXTERNAL Noise fixture pinned in crypto/cacophony_vectors.json. Android and iOS agreeing with each other is not conformance.
gates.closure_requirement: Pin an independently maintained Noise implementation/vector source (immutable upstream commit, licence, source SHA-256, fixture SHA-256, reviewer, review date) for Noise_XX_25519_ChaChaPoly_BLAKE2s with the GMP2 prologue; require external==Python==Android==Swift; add a one-byte mutation proving the gate fails; then flip crypto.test_conformance _conformance_status from UNPINNED.

gates.reason: The full embedded archive requires model weights that are not committed and not network-fetched on the shipping critical path.
gates.closure_requirement: Pin and reproducibly restore the approved model + corpus; build the MEDIUM archive with embeddings; record corpus_sha256.

gates.reason: Stage 4A split the Android gate. The Archive-only LIGHT binary (links only :core; :llm is testImplementation-only) does NOT need llama.cpp/model/Oracle. This repo-owned shipping-artifact gate runs the scoped :app:lintLightRelease/:app:assembleLightRelease/:app:bundleLightRelease, captures the resolved lightRelease classpath (rejecting :llm/:mesh/llama/ggml/godstone_llm), and inspects the real APK/AAB + merged manifest. OPEN until a green run is recorded below as evidence.
gates.closure_requirement: Green release-gates.yml / android-archive-only-release run on the branch tip; record the run ID, commit SHA, APK SHA-256, AAB SHA-256, the resolved lightRelease dependency graph artifact, and the binary+manifest inspection result. The merged lightRelease manifest must grant no INTERNET/BLE/radio/location permission and the APK/AAB must contain no .gguf/libllama/libggml/libgodstone_llm/LlamaBridge/:mesh/Oracle/cross-tier asset.

gates.reason: llama.cpp revision and native build must be pinned and reproducibly restored before the full app/LLM release build is evidence.
gates.closure_requirement: Pin llama.cpp revision; vendor/restore the XCFramework/JNI binary reproducibly; no placeholder framework.

gates.reason: Requires real Android and iOS device hardware over the BLE/Wi-Fi Aware link layer. Not runnable in CI. A-01 cannot CLOSE on unit tests alone.
gates.closure_requirement: Implement ADR-002 link layer (bounded BLE framing, fragmentation/reassembly, HS1/HS2/HS3 handshake driver, replay rejection, no plaintext fallback); then Hardware Case 0: Android<->iOS encrypted GMP/2.1 frame round-trip, authentication, same held-set digest, disconnect/reconnect safety, tamper+replay rejection, packet capture with no application plaintext.

gates.reason: Requires on-device accessibility audit (VoiceOver/TalkBack) and is not part of repository-verification.
gates.closure_requirement: On-device accessibility review against the shipping UI; record findings and remediation.

gates.reason: Requires on-device battery/thermal profiling under sustained mesh/Oracle load.
gates.closure_requirement: On-device battery/thermal measurements against agreed budgets.

gates.reason: Release signing keys and store submission are offline, non-network operations performed on a sealed workstation; not part of CI.
gates.closure_requirement: Offline signing with committed (non-secret) signing-config metadata + store review approval.
